classification.difficultyReason: Use the specified method to calculate two intercepts and translate the resulting coordinates into each straight-line sketch.

content.prompt: Sketch the graph of each line by calculating the coordinates of the $x$- and $y$-intercepts.

answer.worked:
Set $y=0$:
$$\begin{align*}2x+0&=4\\x&=2\end{align*}$$
Set $x=0$:
$$\begin{align*}2(0)+y&=4\\y&=4\end{align*}$$
Plot $(2,0)$ and $(0,4)$ and draw the straight line through them.

spec.description: Complete solution graph with labelled intercept points, arrowed axes and no grid or origin label.
